what_was_wrong: the v1 record stated '8 substantive + 2 label + 1 status of 4,140 shared, no residual moved'. The reviewer (3563fd2 A-2) and the coordinator both re-diffed it. THE SUBSTANTIVE COUNT AND THE STRING COUNT WERE RIGHT -- 8, and 2 label + 1 status = 3 string. 'NO RESIDUAL MOVED' WAS WRONG: BOTH identity_residual leaves moved (CONDVALUE 3.5527e-15 -> 4.4409e-16, HAZARD 1.1102e-16 -> 0.0). A residual tracks the magnitude of what it checks, so it moves when that grows; it is neither a substantive change NOR an unchanged number, and calling it the latter was the error.
